A '''gemologist''' was a person who studied [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstones]]. [[Vocis Kenit]]'s [[Vocis Kenit's brother|brother]] was one.<ref name="TFOP">''[[The Far Orbit Project]]''</ref> When [[Captain-Supervisor]] [[Grammel]] demanded to know the properties of a shard of the [[Kaiburr crystal]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] protested that he was not a gemologist.<ref name="SotME">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref>
